Personality: Tafsut, a prominent figure of the Masaesyli, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Tafsut owes allegiance to the Masaesyli Numidia, hailing from the noble house of Masaesyli. Historical Record: Wife of Syphax, head of the Masaesyli, a Numidian house of the Masaesyli. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
